overview: The board approved several residential variances, including a conversion of a two-family dwelling into a three-family at 12 George Street and various fence and parking improvements. Members also voted to move the regular meeting start time one hour earlier and discussed upcoming administrative updates to the zoning ordinance.

items.title: 436 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Continued the petition for a 10-foot fence variance to allow the applicant time to meet with the police chief regarding safety requirements.

items.title: 590 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Continued the request for modification of previously granted relief to allow the applicant to coordinate site plan details with the Community Development Board.

items.title: 45 Bowen Street
items.summary: Approved a variance for a front-yard off-street parking space at a two-family dwelling, conditioned on the space being restricted to compact vehicles to prevent sidewalk obstruction.

items.title: 20 Macklin Road
items.summary: Approved a variance for an 8-foot fence based on security needs and safety concerns related to a steep rock ledge and property topography.

items.title: 12 George Street
items.summary: Approved variances and a special permit to convert a historic two-family dwelling into a three-family dwelling, involving a full architectural restoration supported by the historical commission. The board found that the project's historical significance and unique configuration justified relief, despite neighbor concerns regarding density and fire safety.

items.title: 22 Wilson Street
items.summary: Approved a variance to construct a roof over a front deck that encroached on the front yard setback, citing the property's unique ledge constraints and previous porch configuration.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Rules of Order
items.summary: Approved past meeting minutes and voted to move the start time for regular ZBA meetings from 7:30 PM to 6:30 PM beginning in May 2023. The board also discussed pursuing administrative zoning ordinance updates to address unintended procedural burdens.
